name: Eldoria Catacombs
description: Ancient burial tunnels beneath the city, now corrupted by cult magic and devil-worship.

secret_entrance.title: Secret Entrance - Wine Cellar
secret_entrance.description: Krane's estate wine cellar. A hidden door behind a wine rack leads down into darkness. The smell of brimstone wafts up from below.

upper_catacombs.title: Upper Catacombs
upper_catacombs.description: Ancient burial niches line the walls, their occupants long since turned to dust. Fresher corpses lie scattered about—Krane's failed experiments and sacrifices.

encounters.description: The dead rise to defend their master!

guard_post.title: Cult Guard Post
guard_post.description: A chamber converted into a guardroom. Weapons, armor, and supplies are stacked here. Cultist guards rest between patrols.

encounters.description: Cultist guards leap to their feet!

ritual_preparation.title: Ritual Preparation Chamber
ritual_preparation.description: Tables covered with ritual implements, dark tomes, and alchemical equipment. This is where Krane prepares his dark magic.

encounters.description: A cult sorcerer and his imp familiar attack!

devils_sanctum.title: Devil's Sanctum
devils_sanctum.description: The deepest chamber, where Krane made his pact. A pentagram of iron is burned into the floor. The air reeks of sulfur. Syndic Valerius Krane stands in the center, a horned devil at his side. Two keys rest on a pedestal behind them.

encounters.description: Syndic Krane turns to face you, dark magic crackling around his hands! 'You've meddled in affairs far beyond your understanding!' he snarls. 'Terminate them!' he commands the devil!
